content_sections.heading: Rajkot Rajpath Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available - 1 for Admin Assistant, 2 for Traffic Inspector cum Field Supervisor (Electrical), 3 for Traffic Inspector cum Field Supervisor (Mechanical), 1 for Vigilance Inspector (Transportation) and 1 for Data Entry Operator.

content_sections.heading: Rajkot Rajpath Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Admin Assistant: Post Graduation Diploma in Human Resource Management (PGDHRM) or Master Degree in Business Administration (Human Resource Management) from Government recognized University. Minimum One (01) year of relevant experience. Traffic Inspector cum Field Supervisor (Electrical): Bachelor in Engineering (Electrical) or Diploma in Engineering (Electrical) from Government recognized University or Institution. Minimum One (01) year of relevant experience. Traffic Inspector cum Field Supervisor (Mechanical): Bachelor in Engineering (Mechanical) or Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical) from Government recognized University or Institution. Minimum One (01) year of relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Rajkot Rajpath Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / www.rmc.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for RRL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 15th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for various posts in Rajkot Rajpath Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for RRL Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the RRL Various Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years as of 15th October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the RRL Recruitment 2026 notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the posts in RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary for the posts ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the RRL Various Posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post and include qualifications like PGDHRM/MBA(HRM), BE/Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical, B.Com + LLB, and Diploma in IT/BCA/BSc IT/PGDCA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for RRL Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for RRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Rajkot Rajpath, which is https://www.rmc.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.
